|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “May carry 2 passengers. Ability = 1/2. May move as a 'react'. Each Tusken Raider present is power +1. Creature Vehicles do not suspend Scum and Villainy. During your turn, may place in Used Pile to ▲Bantha Herd.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Bantha (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “May add 2 ‘riders’ (passengers). Ability = 1/2. May move as a ‘react.’ Tusken Raiders here are power +1. Scum And Villainy ignores creature vehicles. During your deploy phase, may deploy one Bantha Herd from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' “carry” → “add”; “passengers.” → “‘riders’ (passengers).”; “'react'. Each” → “‘react.’”; “Raider present is” → “Raiders here are”; removed “Creature Vehicles do not suspend”; “and Villainy.” → “And Villainy ignores creature vehicles.”; “turn,” → “deploy phase,”; “place in Used Pile to ▲Bantha Herd.” → “deploy one Bantha Herd from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards2.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown); page 3, slip 27.
